wish: someone should make a game where you have to beat a copy of yourself as the final boss
spec:
Record 10 seconds of your own moving and shooting in a small arena. Then face a ghost that replays those exact moves and shots as the final boss.
Drag or use arrow keys to move, Fire or Space to shoot; hit the ghost 5 times before it costs you 3 lives.
No levels, no network; only your best win time is saved on this device.
